summary: The run has reached natural expiry: the controller reports no remaining time budget, and no explicit stop reason, so no further product is warranted and the draft still holds the last accepted feedback product (operation 7b02762f79c7467da88b3a8ce83fbb8d). Nothing was changed this turn. Final state of the investigation: audit spec v13 with all units checked, and eleven confirmed in-scope obligations, each witnessed by a fixed artifact executed by the trusted runner in a clean copy and then reviewed with no open issue - election-term context published below an adopted term (substitute stream layer and production TCP transport); client requests left unresolved on an inactive raft and one accepted while leading left unresolved after shutdown; a second, different vote persisted for the same term; two leaders of one term, with the overlap-window variant recorded as a bounded negative that holds; GetConfiguration reporting index zero for a configuration established at index one; a reported commit index naming an entry the voting quorum does not store; a leader with a reachable quorum stepping down under the lease check; the commit context left below applied state on the install path with the log intact, again with the log truncated at the snapshot index, and again after a restart restoring the node's own snapshot; and VerifyLeader confirming leadership on non-voter acknowledgements with one non-voter against two voters and with two non-voters against three voters. Two further anomalies were investigated and explained rather than reported as defects: the cached last-log report versus the effective last index after a snapshot is adopted, and the non-voter election suspicion, which the located suffrage guard on both the vote and pre-vote paths refutes. Open items for a later run: the repair locations for the whole set with no source naming the intended layer; no external consumer exercised for the client-contract findings; the campaign path of a server without a vote only partly read; the transfer path accepting a non-voter target and reporting success with no leader established, uncovered by any obligation; and the deferred third-party SetHeartbeatHandler transports, the MonotonicLogStore and snapshot-compaction interplay, the nested fuzzy and raft-compat modules, and mixed reachable-voter/non-voter layouts. Unused capacity at expiry: 2 audit units, 19 experiments, 9 semantic reviews and 12 revisions.
